happy_path.summary: The dev smoke run completes the normal path end to end on this head.

blockers.summary: Saturated cache degrades the retry path
blockers.failure_sequence: A saturated optional cache evicts one low-priority entry, so a later retry recomputes it and the abnormal path runs slower than designed.
preconditions: optional cache is at its configured capacity
a lower-priority entry is selected for eviction
blockers.risk_rationale: The degradation is confined to the retry path on a non-production target, and the normal path the deploy exists to expose is unaffected.

resolution.rationale: Abnormal-path hardening becomes the next increment so humans can exercise the working normal path now.

human_report.summary: The retry-path degradation ships as issue #94 and re-blocks at production promotion.

blockers.summary: Claimed path collision does not occur
blockers.failure_sequence: The reviewer claimed two output aliases resolve to one path and overwrite the canonical input.
blockers.risk_rationale: If true, the collision would corrupt a review input, but the exact identity probe refutes the prerequisite.

objection.rationale: The exact consumer resolves the two fixture paths to different portable identities before any write.

rebuttal.rationale: The direct probe refutes the claimed alias.

resolution.rationale: The failure sequence was directly refuted.

blockers.summary: Defence-in-depth transport header is still missing
blockers.failure_sequence: A dev response leaves the service without the hardening header, so a future reachable path would lose one defence layer.
preconditions: the dev service answers an unauthenticated health request
blockers.risk_rationale: No reachable exploitation sequence has been demonstrated against the dev surface; the header is layered defence rather than a defect.

resolution.rationale: Precautionary hardening is tracked as the first item of the next cycle; any demonstrated reachable path converts it back to fix-now.

human_report.summary: The missing hardening header ships as issue #94 and re-blocks at production promotion.

ship_decision.rationale: The normal path is verified on the dev target and nothing fix-now is retained, so the increment ships and humans can hit it.
